print_errors.note: The printed ISBN has only 12 digits (3+3+4+1+1), but an ISBN-13 needs 13. A digit is probably missing in the print. Transcribed exactly as printed.

notes: p001: Page 1 starts the book, so the plain marker is used (no '+' and no (تابع)). Title harakat checked at up to 1400 dpi: الدُّرَر (shadda+damma on د, fatha on the first ر only), النَّقِيَّة, في (no kasra; the kasra under the line belongs to ق), اليُسْرِيَّة (damma on ي, sukun on س, kasra on ر), الصِّديقيَّة. In الصِّديقيَّة only ص (shadda+kasra) and the last ي (shadda+fatha) carry marks. د and ق have none. The small spur under the ص bowl is part of the ص glyph, not a second kasra. This differs from the fuller vocalisation الصِّدِّيقِيَّة in README.md; I followed the print. The author-name line is printed bold among regular lines, so I marked it **…** (CONVENTIONS §5 'bold if printed bold'). The subtitle «وأذكار…» is a plain paragraph, per STRUCTURE. «بالمقطم- القاهرة» uses the printed short dash, glued to the word before it. p001/p003: the dot in «أ.د/» is drawn as a raised filled dot (Arabic period shape in this font); I wrote it as a period '.', matching STRUCTURE. p002: The whole page is bold, so there is no ** markup. Hijri abbreviation «١٤٤٤هـ» is printed with tatweel and kept. The deposit number is printed visually with ٢٠١٧ at the far left and ٢٢٨٣٤ next to the colon. I wrote it in reading/meaning order (number/year) as «٢٢٨٣٤/٢٠١٧»; if the adjudicator prefers the bidi-visual order, it would be «٢٠١٧/٢٢٨٣٤». The ISBN is printed visually with ٩٧٨ at the far left. I wrote it in its meaningful order «٩٧٨-٩٧٧-٦٦١٤-٢-٤» with ASCII hyphens. 'I.S.BN' is kept as printed. p003: The photo is omitted. Caption: «الفقير إلى الله» is regular weight. The next three lines are bold and contrast with it, so each is marked **…**. p004: The roundel is written as plain «بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم» per STRUCTURE §4. The salawat line is a low-resolution raster (335x61 px). Marks were verified at 1100-1500 dpi: shadda+fatha on the second ل and on م of اللَّهمَّ (no damma on ه); fatha on ص and shadda+kasra on ل of صَلِّ; fatha on س and shadda+kasra on ل of وسَلِّم (no mark on و or م); madda on وآله; على/سيدنا/محمد unmarked. على is drawn with a calligraphic returning yeh and is written ى.
